topic_title: Move Over / Slow Down Act — Passing Stopped Service Vehicles
prompt: What penalty applies to a driver who violates the Move Over/Slow Down Act and causes property damage?

options.text: A non-jailable citation punishable exclusively by a $25 municipal fine
Immediate forfeiture of auto registration plates for twelve calendar months
A misdemeanor punishable by fines up to $500, or up to $4,000 if injury results
Mandatory permanent suspension of commercial operator licenses across USA
